label: def:unit-root-f-crystal
title: Unit-root F-crystal
html:
Definition. Unit-root F-crystal

A unit-root F-crystal on a commutative formal group H is an F-crystal whose Frobenius endomorphism acts invertibly (bijectively) on the coordinate ring \mathcal{O}(H). The unit-root condition means there is no nilpotent part in the Dieudonne--Manin decomposition.

Reference: [hazewinkel1978], Chapter V; [zink2002], Section 2.
